parameters.content:
## media-review
Called by media-intake per stored item. Approvers = publishers with role `approver` or `admin`. Card buttons work inside Telegram (Approve Within Chat).
Photo → album + alt (translated, confirmed) → `incoming/gallery/<album>/` via bot-git-commit → wait for gallery.json.
Video → title/description (translated, confirmed) → consent gate for public with children → YouTube upload, translations, playlist.
Timeout leaves status `new`.
